{{Top|leg}}
A '''death fence''' was an electrified perimeter fence that surrounded [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[IM-455 modular garrison|prefabricated garrison bases]]. The fence was ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high and had an adjustable power setting. Base commanders could vary the intensity of the field to either deliver a shock to an individual or electrocute them.
